immediate.judge: I will make an immediate judgment based on the issues as organized. We will move to the verdict stage.

conditional.judge: I will first present a conditional mediation that separates the core responsibilities. The will-drafting procedure, the difference between the notarized copy and the handwritten draft, and the long-running care and account trail will not be treated as one bundle.

dialogues.speaker: a
dialogues.text: Yoon Tae-seong's side can hear a conditional mediation. But by what procedure the will was drawn up has to be put on paper first, or the same confusion just keeps coming back.

dialogues.speaker: b
dialogues.text: Yoon Jeong-hu's side can hear the conditional terms as well. But the difference between the notarised copy and the handwritten draft, and the situation in which I was at our mother's side, must be addressed together.

postpone.judge: I will first fix only the facts that can be confirmed and reserve the rest. We will separate records and testimony when examining who understood Mother's wishes, and how.

dialogues.speaker: a
dialogues.text: Yoon Tae-seong's side can accept reserving a decision. But the will-drafting procedure and our mother's capacity to decide at least have to be drawn out today, or further confusion will only grow.

dialogues.speaker: b
dialogues.text: Yoon Jeong-hu's side also believes the circumstances need a closer look before any hasty conclusion. But please make it clear that reserving a decision is not the same as being cleared.

fact_first.judge: Before moving to a solution, I will organize the facts. We will first fix the order of the will-drafting procedure, the difference between the handwritten draft and the notarized copy, and the long-running care and account trail.

dialogues.speaker: a
dialogues.text: Yoon Tae-seong's side agrees with sorting facts out first. At minimum, the will-drafting procedure and the question of our mother's capacity have to be fixed against the records first.

dialogues.speaker: b
dialogues.text: Yoon Jeong-hu's side can accept facts before solutions. But the situation in which I was at our mother's side, and the responsibility for the paperwork, have to be looked at separately from emotion.
